requirements.statement: The Aurora Allergy & Intolerance clinical summary panel shall be unpopulated and empty at go-live for all migrated patients.
requirements.excerpt: The Aurora Allergy & Intolerance clinical summary panel shall be unpopulated and empty at go-live for all migrated patients, to ensure unverified legacy data does not compromise acute prescribing decisions.
requirements.author: Dr Fiona Gallagher

requirements.statement: Legacy allergy data must never populate a clinical field.
requirements.excerpt: Legacy allergy data must never populate a clinical field, because the Clinical Safety Group ruled it unsafe for prescribing due to inconsistent coding and unverified severity in the legacy PAS.
requirements.author: Dr Fiona Gallagher

requirements.statement: Allergy and intolerance profiles shall be captured directly from the patient by an authorised registered prescriber during the patient's first physical or virtual clinical appointment after go-live.
requirements.excerpt: Allergy and intolerance profiles shall be captured directly from the patient by an authorised registered prescriber during the patient's first physical or virtual clinical appointment after go-live.
requirements.author: Dr Fiona Gallagher

requirements.statement: The electronic prescribing and medicines administration (ePMA) module shall enforce a hard-stop blocking all non-emergency drug orders until point-of-care allergy reconciliation has been completed by an authorised clinician.
requirements.excerpt: The electronic prescribing and medicines administration (ePMA) module shall enforce a hard-stop blocking all non-emergency drug orders until point-of-care allergy reconciliation has been completed by an authorised clinician.
requirements.author: Dr Fiona Gallagher

requirements.statement: Allergy severity and adverse reaction manifestations shall be captured directly from the patient at first appointment, never inferred or derived from automated algorithms or unverified historical free-text notes.
requirements.excerpt: Allergy severity and adverse reaction manifestations shall be captured directly from the patient at first appointment, never inferred or derived from automated algorithms or unverified historical free-text notes.
requirements.author: Dr Fiona Gallagher

requirements.statement: Point-of-care captured allergies shall immediately trigger real-time drug-allergy interaction (DAI) alerts within the Aurora pharmacy engine upon confirmed clinician signing.
requirements.excerpt: Point-of-care captured allergies shall immediately trigger real-time drug-allergy interaction (DAI) alerts within the Aurora pharmacy engine upon confirmed clinician signing.
requirements.author: Dr Fiona Gallagher

requirements.statement: All historical allergy and adverse drug reaction (ADR) records associated with active and archived patient master records in CareTrak PAS (approx. 1.4 million records spanning 2004-2025) shall be migrated into Aurora EPR.
requirements.excerpt: All historical allergy and adverse reaction records associated with active and archived patient master records in CareTrak PAS (approx. 1.4 million records spanning 2004-2025) shall be migrated into Aurora EPR during the cutover window.
requirements.author: David Vance

requirements.statement: Legacy allergen identifiers and free-text substance labels shall undergo best-effort algorithmic matching against the UK NHS SNOMED CT drug and substance subset (release v34.1).
requirements.excerpt: Legacy allergen identifiers and free-text substance labels shall undergo best-effort algorithmic matching against the UK NHS SNOMED CT drug and substance subset (release v34.1).
requirements.author: David Vance

requirements.statement: Where no severity keyword can be parsed from the legacy note, the record shall be migrated with severity defaulted to "Unknown".
requirements.excerpt: Where no severity keyword can be parsed from the legacy note, the record shall be migrated with severity defaulted to "Unknown" and shall remain active and visible in the clinical summary panel pending review at the patient's next encounter.
requirements.author: David Vance

findings.title: Severity Derivation Conflict
findings.why_incompatible: Requirement CLIN-11-R05 states severity defaults to 'Unknown' if parsing fails, while Requirement CLIN-11-R05 (as stated in Chat-03) explicitly prohibits deriving severity from free text.
findings.clinical_consequence: A patient record with a missing or ambiguous allergy severity could lead to incorrect risk assessments and potentially inappropriate treatment decisions.

findings.title: Default Severity in CareTrak Migration
findings.why_incompatible: The migration process (DM-04-R05) defaults severity to 'Unknown' when parsing fails, without explicit clinical validation.
findings.clinical_consequence: A patient record with a missing or ambiguous allergy severity will be migrated with a 'Unknown' severity, potentially leading to inaccurate risk assessments and inappropriate treatment decisions.
